name: Administrator creates academic structure and course
description: Creates linked faculty, department, programme and course records, then verifies they remain available after refresh.
steps: Sign in as an Administrator or Super Admin
Create a faculty, then a department linked to it
Create a programme linked to the department
Create a course linked to the programme
Refresh the module and verify the created records are still listed
expected: All four linked academic records are visible after refresh; invalid parent references are rejected.

name: Academic administration is read-only for students
description: Verifies a student can view academic records but cannot create or delete institutional structure.
steps: Verify the create form is unavailable
Attempt to submit an academic record through the visible interface
expected: The student can view permitted academic data but has no create or delete controls.

name: Enrollment requires an existing student and course
description: Verifies enrollment links a previously authenticated student to an existing course and rejects duplicate enrollment.
steps: Open Academic administration and select Enrollments
Select an existing course and enter a non-existent student account ID
expected: The API rejects the missing student account and no enrollment record is created.
